dct_description_sm: Data were collected in order to analyze the distribution and diversity of diatom (microscopic algae; class Bacillariophyceae) assemblages in surficial sediments of shallow lakes in Wapusk National Park. This provides a reference background and also allowed us to identify key taxa which could be targeted in monitoring programs for the detection of any changes in these shallow aquatic systems within the context of the rapid evolution of thermokarst environments in the Subarctic.
dct_title_s: Diatom assemblages in surficial sediments of shallow lakes in Hudson Bay Lowlands, 2012
